surfaces.label: Long-form description
surfaces.limitation: Viewer may need to expand description; one displayed view is not a click or purchase

surfaces.label: Long-form pinned comment
surfaces.limitation: Pinning depends on channel features, and mobile viewers must expand comments; not everyone sees the link

surfaces.label: Shorts description URL
surfaces.limitation: Plain URL is not clickable; apparent viewer count does not establish outbound funnel impressions

surfaces.label: Shorts comment URL
surfaces.limitation: Plain URL remains non-clickable even if channel is otherwise approved for advanced features

surfaces.label: Shorts related-video link
surfaces.limitation: Clickable internal related-video destination, not a general external merchant URL

surfaces.label: Channel profile site links
surfaces.limitation: Availability as a channel link does not prove any Short viewer navigated to or used the profile

surfaces.label: YouTube Shopping affiliate link
surfaces.limitation: Separate feature and country/merchant approval is needed; do not substitute for generic Shorts description URLs

measurement_plan.hypothesis: A permitted clickable long-form video URL or pinned comment could route eligible viewers to an owned page or permitted product; the scale and profit are unmeasured.
preregister: Creator advanced-feature eligibility and actual clickable URL behavior per format/device
One approved offer and final merchant/checkout counterparty
Source video and placement variant, controlled dates and country/language
Baseline views, actual clickable-link impressions if accessible, resolved outgoing clicks and consented on-site visits
Completed non-duplicate buyer orders and net proceeds with refunds, duties and taxes separately handled
Audience randomization or credible matched comparison, seasonality and other discovery controls
Creator labor and paid promotion cash, privacy-safe aggregate analytics, minimum worthwhile effect
